//: Alpha = actor, beta = target (optional).  Called by PF_MK_<kind> after it has set kind, tags, strength and per-role deltas.  Updates the target's view of the actor, the actor's view of the target, memories, and (for strong moments) every NPC who saw it.
u = an NPC who saw a strong moment (not the actor or target).  Updates their view of the actor and lets them remember it.

Moment 'meal_shared': Ate together.  The one fed trusts a little more (playtest 3: sharing scarce food is a trust signal; with trust +1 a lone start took about 11 days to win anyone over).  Alpha = actor, beta = target.  Optional strength: set pf_m_str_in first (default 30).

Half moment 'meal_shared': updates only u's view of pf_m_other (role pf_mv_role: 1 = it happened to u, 2 = u did it).  For off-screen life, where only one person at a time can be reached (by unique id).
